Me, June and Kirsten spent 15 minutes coordinating today’s cacao circle
Me, June, Kirsten and Edge and Node spent 5 hours today offering cacao to the web3 community 🙂🙏
June spent 5 minutes introducing Ahmed to us
Me and June spent 10 minutes corresponding to make arrangements to meet with Organic Valley Cooperative Farmers from Napa California tomorrow
Me, June and Tripp spent 1.5 hours sharing insights on growing Agroverse today

June spent 3 hours and 15 minutes organizing this get together to introduce me to Patty 

Will follow up with Patty on the kitchen facilities they have in the public library in South Bay as well as get introduced to their chamber of commerce there 

Seems there are lots of chocolatiers seeking chocolate supplies

Me, June Jo, Tripp and Ahmed spent 5 hours today doing trend spotting as well as exploring the future trends of of the holistic and regenerative movement. Going back to community, defining what Regeneration is is becoming a very clear direction
Me, @kikiscocoa and June Jo spent 2 hours discussing about food as well as exploring how raw cacao tastes like
